WeComAdapter — ChannelPort for WeCom (企业微信) Application.

Receiving: HTTP webhook server runs on a dedicated OS thread. WeCom POSTs XML to the configured URL; thread pushes WeComEvents to a module-level Channel. Main loop calls tryRecvEvent().

Sending: WeCom REST API (POST /cgi-bin/message/send). access_token is fetched lazily and refreshed ~1 minute before expiry.

Signature: SHA1(sort(callbackToken, timestamp, nonce).join("")) Used for both URL verification (GET) and message receipt (POST).

Message types sent: text — plain text reply markdown — structured rich reply (headers, bold, colour tags)

Config env vars: WECOM_CORP_ID, WECOM_CORP_SECRET, WECOM_AGENT_ID, WECOM_CALLBACK_TOKEN, WECOM_WEBHOOK_PORT (default 8081)

Module-level channel — opened once, valid for daemon lifetime.Simple dedup table: msgId → timestamp. Prevents processing WeCom retries.
